title: Biggest and smallest
examples: Teacher, how do I know which is bigger?
Can we put these toys in order?

explain.say: Look at these two blocks. Which one is bigger?
Now look at three pencils. You can put them in order.
Line up toys from smallest to biggest. That is putting them in order by size.
Look at these three animals. Which one is the biggest?
To line things up, start with the smallest one.
You can build a tower in order of size. Put the biggest block at the bottom.

faq.q: How do I know which is bigger?
faq.a: You can compare the two things side by side. The one that takes up more space is bigger.
asks: How do I tell them apart?

faq.q: Do I always start with the smallest?
faq.a: When putting things in order, you usually start with the smallest one first. Then you go up to the biggest.
asks: Do I go up or down?

faq.q: Can I compare things that are not the same shape?
faq.a: Yes, you can compare shapes, as long as you are comparing their size. You just need to look at how big they seem.
asks: Does it matter what they are?

faq.q: What if the things are almost the same size?
faq.a: If they are very close, you can try to line them up carefully. One will still be just a tiny bit bigger.

faq.q: Is there a word for putting things in order?
faq.a: Yes, the word is order. Putting things in order means lining them up from smallest to biggest, or from biggest to smallest.

facts: We compare two objects to see which is bigger or smaller.
Putting things in order means arranging them from smallest to biggest.
You can order things by size, weight, or height.
The smallest item is the one that takes up the least space.

quiz.say: Look at the two things. Which one is bigger?
quiz.why: The book takes up more space than the pencil.

wrong.0: A pencil is long and thin, so it takes up less space.
wrong.2: The book takes up more space, so they are different sizes.

quiz.say: Things go in order from smallest up. What comes after medium?
quiz.why: The order goes up in size. After medium comes big.

wrong.1: Small comes before medium, at the start of the order.
wrong.2: Tiny is even smaller, so it goes at the very start.

quiz.say: Which row goes from smallest to biggest?
quiz.why: The mouse is smallest, then the dog, then the elephant.

wrong.0: This row starts with the biggest animal, so it goes the other way.
wrong.1: The dog is bigger than the mouse, so the mouse must come first.
